test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

S C R _ W S _ R _ W _ C _ G W S _ R H _

options.text: G D F S R C W
H D F S R C W
E C F S R C W
E D F S R D W

solution:
Given : S C R _ W S _ R _ W _ C _ G W S _ R H _

By checking options :

 
• G D F S R C W → S C R __**G**__ W - S __**D**__ R __**F**__ W - __**S**__ C __**R**__ G W - S __**C**__ R H __**W**__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• H D F S R C W → S C R **__H__** W - S __D__ R __F__ W - __S__ C __R__ G W - S __C__ R H __W__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• E C F S R C W → S C R **__E__** W - S **__C__** R __F__ W - __S__ C __R__ G W - S __C__ R H __W__ → (It Follows the pattern)

__
 
• Option - (3) gives the pattern of "S C R E__ W - S __C__ R __F__ W - __S__ C __R__ G W - S __C__ R H __W__"** **
 
• ** ****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9956329488b426dfa0e604c6a69395a9b18618fa7be123ae21ee49f78138ca.png] 

 
• E D F S R D W → S C R __E__** W - S __D__ R __F__ W - __S__ C __R__ G W - S **__D__** R H __W__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

 

Hence, "**E C F S R C W**" is the correct answer.
